scope: Seven distinct receivers, source-specific illustrations and open adapters; no biological validation.

receivers.input_contract: Pinned tau–MAP6 current-grid transition semantics and declared reachable state class.
receivers.result: Retained terminal-position witness rejects one count-only exact Markov summary.
receivers.limit: Unreviewed guide deduction; not all reductions, default-run validation or finite-PRNG proof.

receivers.input_contract: Admitted binding target, mixture/concentration nuisance and actual joint assay law.
receivers.result: Observation-fibre criteria define a testable identification question and additional-channel receiver.
receivers.limit: Intensity-only witness does not match the studies’ entire joint experiment.

receivers.input_contract: PhotoLean two-tag response model, matched slope and physical positive-rate domain.
receivers.result: Existing formalized intensity ambiguity and lifetime discriminator.
receivers.limit: External prior; no full build audit or universal mixed-mechanism converse.

receivers.input_contract: Joint confidence set with justified coverage and admitted true mechanism.
receivers.result: Singleton target image supports reporting; otherwise abstain.
receivers.limit: Joint report-and-error bound is not conditional-on-report error or protection from misspecification.

receivers.input_contract: Stable stationary latent OU model, same direct perturbation and identified context/measurement interfaces.
receivers.result: Retained query-specific transport criterion and missing-direction snapshot illustration.
receivers.limit: Primary full-page 403; illustration unreviewed, not equal trajectories or general transfer impossibility.

receivers.input_contract: Declared spatial resolution, constrained interaction family and directed intervention target.
receivers.result: Separate family-parameter uniqueness from causal direction and tissue admission.
receivers.limit: Unrestricted gauge and elementary SCM pair are not established Celcomen counterexamples.

receivers.input_contract: Matched R/A/B/AB context/scale, verified phase/coordinates, admitted assays and exposure.
receivers.result: Scale-specific interaction and predeclared component-split validation specification.
receivers.limit: Design-only; no actual split, frozen weights, calibrated intervals or causal/diploid claim.
